title: AI compute deals test Southeast Asia's limits
lede: The week of September 7-13, 2026 brought the clearest sign yet that APAC's data centre build-out has entered a new phase: anchor tenants are now signing directly with regional operators, while governments and grids strain to keep up. OpenAI anchored the narrative, committing to more than 900MW of dedicated AI compute across Firmus's Malaysian sites — a deal that pushed the Nvidia-backed Australian developer toward an IPO and underlined Malaysia's emergence as a frontline AI infrastructure market. Financing followed demand, with Indonesia's Zankore securing a US$3.1 billion GPU loan, NextDC raising AU$1.1 billion in convertible notes, and Blackstone's AirTrunk seeking US$1.6 billion ahead of a Singapore listing. Yet the period's counterweight was equally clear: Thailand froze 49 projects, Malaysia's regulator warned data centres already consume a tenth of national electricity, and Sydney's transmission operator flagged more than 20GW of connection enquiries against largely committed capacity. Demand is no longer the question; power, water and regulation are.

themes.heading: OpenAI's Malaysia bet lifts Firmus
themes.narrative: OpenAI signed a multi-year agreement to lease dedicated AI compute from two Firmus AI Factory sites in Malaysia, pushing the Australian developer past 900MW of contracted capacity. The deal, reported across several outlets, makes OpenAI the anchor customer for the Nvidia-backed firm's regional expansion. Firmus is already arranging meetings with prospective investors ahead of a potential IPO, seeking to capitalise on the win.
themes.heading_zh: OpenAI在马来西亚的布局提振Firmus
themes.narrative_zh: OpenAI签署了一份多年期协议，从Firmus位于马来西亚的两个AI Factory站点租用专属AI算力，使这家澳大利亚开发商的签约容量突破900MW。据多家媒体报道，该交易使OpenAI成为这家Nvidia支持的公司区域扩张的锚定客户。Firmus已在筹划与潜在投资者会面，为可能的IPO做准备，以期借此胜势获利。

themes.heading: Debt and equity flood the sector
themes.narrative: Capital raising dominated the week's financial pages. Indonesia's Zankore signed a US$3.1 billion loan — among Asia's largest GPU-backed debt deals — to fund an AI Factory of up to 1GW, while NextDC raised AU$1.1 billion in convertible notes and AirTrunk was reported to be seeking roughly US$1.6 billion for a Singapore REIT listing. S&P expects Malaysian operators to turn to offshore US dollar bonds as local banks tighten, and Singapore-headquartered firms were shown to account for 98 percent of the US$11.5 billion raised across Southeast Asia.
themes.heading_zh: 债务与股权资金涌入数据中心行业
themes.narrative_zh: 融资活动主导了本周的财经版面。印度尼西亚的Zankore签署了31亿美元贷款——跻身亚洲最大规模的GPU支持债务交易之列——用于建设最高1GW的AI Factory；与此同时，NextDC发行了11亿澳元可转债，AirTrunk则被报道正寻求约16亿美元用于新加坡REIT上市。S&P预计，随着本地银行收紧放贷，马来西亚运营商将转向离岸美元债券；数据还显示，总部位于新加坡的公司占东南亚115亿美元融资总额的98%。

themes.heading: Regulators confront power and water strain
themes.narrative: Thai authorities suspended construction on 49 data centre projects while drafting rules on electricity consumption and community impact. In Malaysia, the energy regulator said data centres already account for nearly a tenth of national power use, a separate analysis projected a 9GW gas-fired shortfall by 2032, and Selangor's government said it is closely monitoring water and power capacity. Singapore tabled its Digital Infrastructure Bill with energy-efficiency transition periods, Sydney's Transgrid warned of more than 20GW of connection enquiries, and New South Wales opened a review of how data centres should pay for water infrastructure.
themes.heading_zh: 监管机构直面电力与水资源压力
themes.narrative_zh: 泰国当局暂停了49个数据中心项目的建设，同时起草有关电力消耗和社区影响的法规。在马来西亚，能源监管机构表示数据中心已占全国用电量的近十分之一；另一项独立分析预测到2032年将出现9GW的燃气发电缺口；雪兰莪州政府表示正在密切监测水电容量。新加坡提交了《数字基础设施法案》，其中包含能效过渡期安排；悉尼的Transgrid警告连接咨询量已超过20GW；新南威尔士州则启动了一项关于数据中心应如何为供水基础设施付费的审查。

themes.heading: Australia builds toward compute export
themes.narrative: Australia pressed its case as an AI infrastructure exporter, with Nvidia partnering local cloud providers and operators to bring 2GW of compute online by 2027. Canberra's positioning leans on land and energy advantages as regional demand climbs. On the ground, Goodman Group won approval for a 135MW data center in northern Sydney, adding to the country's development pipeline.
themes.heading_zh: 澳大利亚推进算力出口建设
themes.narrative_zh: 澳大利亚积极推进其作为AI基础设施出口国的定位，Nvidia正与本地云服务商和运营商合作，计划到2027年上线2GW算力。堪培拉的这一定位依托于土地和能源优势，以把握区域需求攀升的机遇。在具体项目层面，Goodman Group获得了在悉尼北部建设一座135MW数据中心的批准，进一步充实了该国的开发管线。

themes.heading: China's chip self-sufficiency push
themes.narrative: Chinese AI chipmakers including Huawei are raising processor prices as a shortage of high-bandwidth memory lifts production costs under US export restrictions. JD Cloud is partnering with domestic GPU designer Moore Threads on a 100,000-GPU cluster, underscoring the pivot to homegrown silicon. The shift has regional spillover: Malaysia is leaning toward Huawei chips for its sovereign AI program despite US warnings, while GLP broke ground on a 200MW campus in Foshan.
themes.heading_zh: 中国推进芯片自给自足
themes.narrative_zh: 包括华为在内的中国AI芯片制造商正在提高处理器价格，原因是在美国出口限制下，高带宽内存短缺推高了生产成本。京东云正与本土GPU设计商摩尔线程合作建设10万卡GPU集群，凸显向国产芯片的转型。这一转变产生了区域外溢效应：尽管美国发出警告，马来西亚在其主权AI计划中仍倾向于采用华为芯片；与此同时，GLP在佛山为一个200MW园区破土动工。
